title: Esteban Mara to play Dodong in 2027 ‘Zsazsa Zaturnnah' revival
summary: The producers of the musical "Zsazsa Zaturnnah Ze Parteeeh!" announced on Tuesday that Esteban Mara will play Dodong in the production celebrating its 20th anniversary.
